items.caption: This Shang-style oracle-script form depicts a person with a marked head, which paleographic analyses connect with head or top-of-head uses of 天. Early uses and the proposed relationship to the later sense “sky, heaven” remain disputed.
items.alt: Black glyph with a long horizontal stroke above a human-like figure whose lower strokes spread apart.
items.selection_reason: The visible form is legible and supports the entry’s discussion of the human-figure and emphasized-head analysis, while the caption makes clear that this interpretation does not settle the earliest meaning.

limitations.text: The head-related interpretation is not a settled account of the character’s origin: sources report head-related early uses, while another account treats the original word as “sky.” The evidence does not establish a certain semantic chronology from head or top to sky or heaven.
The form is presented as a modern redraw of an oracle-script exemplar; the available evidence does not establish an absolute date for that specific exemplar.
